name: env_transition_curves
description: How the weather moves between states. Rain changes in seconds because it is noise on the screen; wetness changes in minutes because water soaks in and dries out; wind leans fast and relaxes slowly, which is what makes a gust read as a gust rather than as a fade. A pair entry overrides the default for one ordered transition, so a storm can arrive in twenty seconds and take seventy-five to leave.
note: Read by the weather system that also reads assets/env/env_weather_profiles.json. Every driver named in the profiles must have a curve here, and every curve must name a driver that exists — check_environment.py fails the build on either direction of that contract, because a driver with no curve jumps and a curve with no driver is dead.

curves.linear: constant rate, for values the eye does not track
curves.ease_in_out: smooth at both ends, the default
